Name: (FS) Show Some Skin
Author: TrappedEgo
Description:
i always thought there wasn't much shoulder shirts or belly shirts.. so here is this poorly rushed mod! 

this is a small collection of shirts that shows of some shoulders and some belly! nothing too big but i dont mind making it show some more belly and what not!

as well as i am always open to criticism and to improve, also! if you have any ideas of your own you think i should add! let me know as well! this mod pairs really well with any and every sleeve mod, i would recommending looking into some! thank you for stopping by!
